text: $27.40, −0.51% Friday, −5.16% on the week. Busy pipeline fortnight: an exclusive licence with Starna Therapeutics for three pre-IND in-vivo CAR-T programmes in autoimmune disease (18 Nov, rights outside Greater China), and up to $1.5bn of development funding from Blackstone Life Sciences through 2028 for the GLP-1 obesity programme (11 Nov), on top of a raised full-year outlook and a new CFO announced with Q3 on 3 Nov.
